api.from_tcg: from_tcg(raw, expected_cpu=N, expected_vcpus=M) returns a versioned receipt with registers in frozen CPU_REGISTERS order plus source digest and retained context. Source schema must be exact tcg-state-v1.
api.from_unicorn: Read-only from_unicorn(uc) returns the SAME new architecture57 contract for a UC_MODE_32 engine. Reads actual DR6/7 once; derives DR4/5 aliases without consulting or writing their padding slots. Checks 32-bit present CS against actual descriptor bytes.
api.fail_closed: Canonical57Error for unrepresentable widths/modes, unknown or missing source fields, topology/stop mismatch, malformed exact hex, contradictory TOP, unknown debug semantics, CR4.DE=1, nonzero extended R8..15/XMM8..15. No partial result and no masked truncation.
api.scope: A versioned projection and readback adapter, not a production CPU loader. The test loader explicitly loads retained ELF/GDT before selectors; it is not substituted for the frozen replay machine.

canonical_mapping.names: EAX EBX ECX EDX ESI EDI EBP ESP EIP EFLAGS
canonical_mapping.mapping: QEMU gpr indices 0,3,1,2,6,7,5,4; full EIP/EFLAGS. Every selected value must already fit uint32. No AND 0xffffffff.

canonical_mapping.names: FPCW FPSW FPTAG FIP FDP FCS FDS FOP MXCSR
canonical_mapping.mapping: Control/status actual uint16; TOP checked against FPSW bits11..13. Fulltag from physical raw FP80 and actual empty mask. FIP/FDP must fit uint32 in this qualified legacy32 projection despite the Unicorn FIP/FDP API accepting 64 bits. FCS/FDS fit uint16, FOP11 bits, MXCSR16 bits.

canonical_mapping.names: CS DS ES FS GS SS
canonical_mapping.mapping: Actual selectors. Full source cached base/limit/flags retained separately in receipt context; canonical six scalar fields cannot encode those hidden caches. Their base must fit uint32.
Actual 32-bit values. CR0.PE required; EFLAGS.VM refused. CR4.DE=1 makes DR4/5 unreadable and refuses the complete57 projection.

Existing list[selector,base,limit,flags]. Base<=uint32. GDTR/IDTR require actual selector/flags zero and limit<=uint16; LDTR/TR retain selector16/limit32/flags32. Nonzero ignored fields are rejected, never silently zeroed.

Physical registers R0..7 as [mantissa64,signExponent16], independent of TOP. Empty physical payloads retained. Logical FXSAVE slot j maps to physical (TOP+j)&7 only when interpreting the FXSAVE image.
128-bit integer low64 | (high64<<64). Extra XMM8..15 must be zero or refuse; no silent drop of live inaccessible fields.
DR0..3/6/7 actual32; DR4=DR6 and DR5=DR7 only with DE=0. These are architectural aliases, not absent source fields or invented zeros.

local_unicorn_findings.fp_top: Unique normal, +/-zero, denormal, infinity, NaN, unnormal and pseudo-denormal FP80 patterns remained in identical FP0..7 API slots at TOP=0,3,7. Actual FXSAVE at TOP3 rotated logical ST slots exactly as expected.
local_unicorn_findings.fulltag: API writes of 0000/5555/aaaa all read aa94 with the same nonempty payloads; ffff reads ffff; 300c reads ba9c. API tag writes encode empty/nonempty, and nonempty types are reclassified from the physical payload.
local_unicorn_findings.dr_conflict: API DR4/5 can independently retain 12345678/23456789 while actual MOV EAX,DR4/5 at DE=0 returns DR6/7. At DE=1 both encodings raise UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID. New adapter never equates API padding to architectural evidence.
local_unicorn_findings.mmr_truncation: Actual UC_MODE32 writes base=0x100234567 read back0x234567 for all four MMRs. GDTR/IDTR also discard selector/flags and truncate limit0x12345 to0x2345. Adapter rejects such inputs before projection.
local_unicorn_findings.scalar_widths: EAX/EIP/CR2/DR0 writes >32 bits truncate in local API; FCS/FDS truncate16. FIP/FDP API retains64, but current projection requires architectural legacy32 range. All unsupported high bits are refused rather than relying on API behavior.

actual_source_verification.original_fxsave_crosscheck: roundtrip32-v2 guest.bin physical payloads, TOP/fulltag and FIP/FDP matched projection; guest.bin is original frozen data.
actual_source_verification.actual_high64_rejected: nonzero R8..15/XMM8..15 cannot be silently discarded by 32-bit projection
actual_source_verification.restore_reuse: Before/after and disturbed/second-B canonical projections match on both 32-bit restore sources, with no native recollection.
actual_source_verification.instruction_counterexample: Actual Unicorn MOV DR6,EAX followed by MOV EBX,DR4 updated new readback aliases and EBX consistently, while raw DR4 padding remained zero.

tests.emulator_limits: Each instruction case uses Unicorn timeout=100000us and count<=32; shell process limit15/20 seconds. No VM, UI, network or original program instructions.
tests.frozen_before_execution: Source/DLL SHA manifests were written before oracle, test and readback executions; no executed source was subsequently modified.
tests.refusals: Missing/unknown/malformed fields; TOP mismatch; wrong/un-stopped VP; DE=1; high-width GPR/IP/FP pointer/CR/DR/MMR; GDTR ignored fields; nonzero extended XMM; high64; v8086; incompatible CS descriptor. Validation does not use removable assert statements.

limitations: Authenticating raw JSON capture, exact source/binary/configuration, stop epoch and memory is a caller responsibility. Digest in receipt is an identifier, not authentication. Arbitrary plausible in-range GPR replacement is not automatically detected; source file/SHA must be pinned externally.

The frozen tools/terminal_unit_frontends_trace.py still reads Unicorn DR4/5 padding. It has not been changed, and historical acceptance records are not rewritten. Only callers that explicitly adopt the new schema and readback adapter may compare architectural57 results.

No hidden segment-cache restoration proof: CS descriptor memory is checked, but stale cache versus memory cannot be recovered through these 57 API values alone. Full source cached segment metadata is retained for separate comparison.

No compatibility-mode or long-mode projection. Real Windows WOW64 normally has long mode active, which is deliberately refused until a separate lossless contract handles high registers, segment bases and wider state.

A successful initial 57-register write/read comparison proves representability of those particular states, not correctness of arbitrary future Unicorn/x87 instructions, pending exceptions, privileged events or replay.
No RAM, device, kernel/native handle, driver, scheduler, resource-lifetime, original-game or complete machine acceptance is implied. Event/RAM evidence will receive a separate review when available.
Both adapters must be called while their engine is stopped and exclusively owned; the Unicorn API provides no per-read multi-register epoch attestation here.

storage.cleanup: No old evidence/runtime removed; new small evidence only.
